title: Data source comparison
how: The same activity is matched by start time ±2 minutes. A highlighted cell = the difference exceeds the tolerance (duration / distance 2%, climb 10%, weighted power 3%, training load 5%). Each cell shows A / B.
tss_tip:
Hover a training load cell to see how each side computed it (power / pace / heart rate, the FTP used and its source).
Running power load differing from WKO5 is expected: WKO5 uses the manually entered FTP and does not update from the PD model's modelled threshold power; COROS / TP sources use your CP test, or without one the modelled threshold power of the Stryd power PD model (estimate).
